title: research: classify rational rank-one gauges in P112 fit
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Classifies every rational rank-one basis update `G=I+uv^T` whose left and right supports have union of size exactly four, on every four-channel block of the PR3335 rank-34 P112 factorization. Diagonal similarity reduces each support pattern to rational overlap products; exact affine equations and hyperplane avoidance classify every source/inverse diagonal-zero cell. This is the complete rank-one family on a four-channel block, not arbitrary `GL4(Q)`, rank-two updates or update sequences.

## Result

The exact classifier checks 1,294 support/diagonal-flag cells: 373 feasible and 921 obstructed, yielding 365 distinct rational source/inverse support pairs. Pricing those pairs on all 46,376 channel quadruples checks 16,927,240 cases. The minimum invoice remains 224 on every quadruple; no strict improvement occurs. The full-support subset is worse (minimum 228). No kappa or supplier change is claimed.

## Validation

- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-plane-rank34-rankone-update --check-only`
- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-plane-rank34-rankone-update`

The registered replay passed on CPython 3.12 in normal and optimized modes, including exact support-cell reconstruction, all tariff receipts and dense scalar-identity controls.

## Task and overlap

Scientific base: canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. A refreshed text scan at 2026-10-19 10:10 UTC covered 729 open PRs and 2,595 Discussion records. Merged PR1923 exhausts ternary Householder reflections on a different symmetric ten-term P112 witness; Discussion #2072 studies between-call transvections; PR1950 mentions a rank-one update in a Lean recovery contract. None is this rational latent-basis gauge family. PR4020, PR4022 and PR4026 are exact rational pair, triple and four-cycle predecessors. Text search is not a novelty certificate and does not inspect every code diff or unpublished work.

## Credit

Matarener/Mark and Claude via Claude Code supplied PR3335's rematching and rank-34 factorization. Arham Tahir's paired-plane audit and credited predecessors supply the full-plane tariff and 224 base invoice. This exact rank-one support classification, verifier and tariff census were prepared by OpenAI Codex with substantial AI assistance; no independent human review or formal proof assistant is claimed.

## Open next questions

Can a rank-two Woodbury update `G=I+UV^T` on four channels lower the invoice? Derive exact coupled matrix/inverse support cells before pricing them. Even a tariff below 160 would only pass the optimistic copy screen; physical realization, dirty-state restoration and supplier admission would remain open.
